transcripts.transcript: Come with me as I show you that the best plans truly do start with a simple yes. Volunteering, learning floral arrangement, and soaking in the beauty of slow, meaningful moments truly made for such a beautiful afternoon. We were prepping for a feast day and it was so surreal to see these come to life and also meet new people along the way. I've always wanted to learn how to make floral arrangements and bouquets, and this was such a perfect way to do so. If you ever have a chance to volunteer for a church, definitely do it and see what you can learn along the way.

some of my favourite places 🤍

if you’re ever in Toronto these are the cafes you should absolutely check out ✨

📍Olivia’s Garden 
a cute and garden-esque ambiance, where you can grab a latte and flowers!! perfect for a study, friend or get together date! they have the cutest flowers and we even got mini bouquets with the purchase of their signature lattes! 

📍De Mello
an award winning coffee roaster right in the heart of Toronto!! the staff are SUPER knowledgeable about their coffee, beans, signature drinks (speaking of which: they have the most innovative drinks and lattes that I haven’t seen elsewhere!! 

📍Amadeus Patisserie 
a European-style pastry shoppe, if you go, go for their pastries!! so many unique desserts and cakes (and delicious bread!!!) 

📍Le Beau Croissanterie 
if I’m ever craving croissants, this is where you’ll find me!! anytime you come in, everything is always fresh and they have lots of cool variety and exciting flavours!!

📍Nord Lyon 
the destination for a genuine French culinary experience! The most unique offering with every pastry carefully crafted! Make sure to give yourself a good 20 minutes to choose because you’ll want to try everything! 

#torontocafes #cafesintoronto #todotoronto #bestcafes #coffeeroaster
